title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Mireille"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")
glimpse(births)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- births |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
births_by_date <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(avg_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    christmas_births = births[date_of_month == 25],
    surrounding_avg = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]),
    christmas_pct_of_baseline = 100 * christmas_births / surrounding_avg,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_births
```
